Constitutional Amendments

Plain language explainers.

Neutral framing with direct impact context for Alabama households and communities.

May 19, 2026 Primary

Amendment 1: Expanded Judicial Authority on Bail

Adds additional violent-crime categories where judges may deny bail before trial.

YES means: Broader pre-trial detention authority for judges in specified cases.
NO means: Current bail framework remains unchanged.
Why this matters: This can affect public safety policy, jail capacity, and due-process debates in local communities.

May 19, 2026 Primary

Amendment 2: District Attorney Salary Protection

Prevents lowering a district attorney's salary during the elected term.

YES means: Compensation is protected mid-term.
NO means: Legislature keeps existing flexibility.
Why this matters: This shapes independence versus accountability in prosecutorial leadership.

Education

Immigration
